  # generated by datamodel-codegen:
  #   filename:  metadata-types.json
  
  from __future__ import annotations
  from typing import Annotated, List, Literal, Union
  from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, RootModel
  
  
  class A(BaseModel):
      kind: Literal['a']
  
  
  class B(BaseModel):
      kind: Literal['b']
  
  
  class Values(RootModel[Union[A, B]]):
      root: Annotated[Union[A, B], Field(discriminator='kind')]
  
  
  class Envelope(BaseModel):
      value: Annotated[Union[A, B], Field(discriminator='kind')]
      values: List[Values]

  models.py
  # generated by datamodel-codegen:
  #   filename:  metadata-types.json
  
  from __future__ import annotations
  from typing import Annotated, List, Literal, Union
  from pydantic.dataclasses import dataclass
  from pydantic import Field
  from typing_extensions import TypeAliasType
  
  
  
  @dataclass
  class A:
      kind: Literal['a']
  
  
  
  @dataclass
  class B:
      kind: Literal['b']
  
  
  
  Values = TypeAliasType("Values", Annotated[Union[A, B], Field(discriminator='kind')])
  
  
  
  @dataclass
  class Envelope:
      value: Annotated[Union[A, B], Field(discriminator='kind')]
      values: List[Values]

  from __future__ import annotations
  from typing import List, TypeAlias, Union
  from msgspec import Struct
  
  
  
  class A(Struct, tag_field='kind', tag='a'):
      pass
  
  
  
  class B(Struct, tag_field='kind', tag='b'):
      pass
  
  
  
  Values: TypeAlias = Union[A, B]
  
  
  
  class Envelope(Struct):
      value: Union[A, B]
      values: List[Values]
